description: U.S. Urban Heat Island Mapping Campaign is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. Retirement Notice: This item is in mature support as of February 2026 and will be retired in December 2026. A replacement item has not been identified at this time. Esri recommends updating your maps and apps to phase out use of this item. Cities in the U.S. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are retiring-2026-12. The bounding box given is -158.2209,18.2965,-65.9679,47.7779. The hub shows 2021-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
